name: Cap
title: capjs.js.org
shortDescription: Cap is a modern, lightweight CAPTCHA solution that leverages proof-of-work (PoW) to enhance security and privacy. It is designed for developers looking to protect their websites from bots without compromising user experience. Cap is easy to integrate, supports multiple modes including invisible and floating, and is fully customizable. Ideal for securing forms, APIs, and login pages against automated threats.
pros: Enhanced privacy with no user tracking
cons: May increase load times due to PoW
